source: Find keys by their value, best match first: the key behind a text seen in the app. Searches every locale, ignoring case, and matches fuzzily unless {0}. Each match has the matched locale and value, and the usages in code with file, line and column.
text: 按值查找 key，最佳匹配排在最前：用于根据应用中看到的文本找到对应的 key。会搜索所有语言，忽略大小写，除非设置 {0}，否则使用模糊匹配。每个匹配项包含匹配的语言和值，以及代码中的引用（含文件、行号和列号）。
